noveltyJustification: All three findings are new: the first security pass on this lineage, and no prior finding covers the state-directory containment, the temp fallback or the per-call store read.
ruledOut: A session id can traverse the state path: ruled out by nudge.cjs:54,745-747 and stateKey hashing.
VIBE_SPEC_FOLDER can point the goal slice outside the checkout: ruled out by goal-slice.cjs:271-303,443-462.
A strict post_tool failure can blank the tool result: ruled out, the entry carries no strict.
The hand-over part can deny a turn: ruled out, armHandoverTurnEnd returns null on every path.
